items.briefing:
The FBI is investigating a service selling over 153 million drivers licence records, which may include Australian data shared through international databases — a reminder that your personal details can be exposed through breaches overseas. Separately, ransomware gangs are increasingly recruiting insiders at organisations to help them bypass security measures, meaning threats can come from within your own workplace, not just external hackers.

**Practical tip:** If you're approached by anyone — online or in person — offering money to share work credentials or access, report it to your manager or IT team immediately.
